title: WM69006: Water Engineering Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Hydrology Labs: Measurement and analysis of rainfall, evapotranspiration,
infiltration and streamflow; water balance studies, design of rain-gauge
network, measurement of flow in open and pressure conduits, measurement of
major and minor friction head losses, measurement of sediment load, in situ
determination of soil moisture, computation of crop water requirements and
irrigation schedule, watershed delineation and characterization. Groundwater
Labs: Groundwater investigation by Resistivity Meter and EM Meter, preparation
of well logs, monitoring of groundwater level and quality, computation of
groundwater inflow and outflow by flownet method, preparation of groundwater
contour maps and their analysis, determination of hydraulic parameters of
confined, and unconfined aquifer systems by pumping test, analysis of stepdrawdown test data. Water Quality Labs: Water characteristics and quality
determination; physical, chemical and bacteriological analysis of water, BOD
test, alum dose, settling tests, filtration, Langalier s index and flocculation
tests.
